media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier cover, Melodie der Liebe (Berlin, 1932); source Internet Archive. Reviewed 2026-07-05: no individual cover designer credited. Anonymous German work, published 1932 → PD ~2003 (§66 UrhG, 70 yrs); underlying photo PD as Lichtbild (50 yrs); reproductions of PD 2-D works stay PD (EU DSM Art. 14). Rights upgraded fair-use → OK (public domain). Assumes no designer later identified; not legal advice. Credit: 'Illustrierter Film-Kurier (1932) (public domain)'.
